// Deployment: HostedMultiTenant so the public clinic self-signup door (/signup, POST /api/auth/signup) is open locally — it is the ONLY profile where AllowsPublicClinicSignup is true. Note it also closes the first-run /setup page and clinic-code join; sign in at /login with an existing account. Remove this block to go back to SelfHostedLan behaviour.
// DataProtection: Required in HostedMultiTenant and fails startup without it (US-6): the framework fallback ring is ephemeral, so every clinic's encrypted credentials die on the next redeploy. .local/ is gitignored.
// Console: The vendor console (platform-console). It is OFF until Port is set — absent means absent, so without this block every /api/platform/* path 404s everywhere and console/ has nothing to talk to. 5443 is a second Kestrel listener beside the public 5000; ⚠️ setting it makes Program.cs configure Kestrel EXPLICITLY, which overrides launchSettings' applicationUrl, so both ports are bound with ListenAnyIP rather than localhost-only. SigningKey MUST differ from the clinic's (Auth:Local:SigningKey, generated into .local/signing-key) — that difference is what makes a clinic token on a console route a 401 rather than a policy decision, and startup fails loud if it is empty while Port > 0. This value is a DEV FIXTURE, same precedent as minioadmin above: a real deployment supplies CONSOLE_SIGNING_KEY from the environment.
// MinIO: HostedMultiTenant stores blobs in MinIO, not on local disk, so the dev keys have to be present or every upload/PDF throws « MinIO is not configured ». docker-compose defaults — non-secret, same precedent as the connection string above.
// Notification: Points the transactional sender at the docker-compose `mailpit` sink (SMTP 1025, UI http://localhost:8025). Signup refuses BEFORE writing anything when Server/FromAddress are empty, so these two are what make the flow runnable at all.
// ConnectionStrings: Local dev DB (docker-compose default creds — non-secret, mirrors docker-compose.yml). The base appsettings.json no longer carries a connection string (secrets are not committed).
